en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ayub bin Nuh, from Safwan bin Yahya, from Mu’awiya bin Ammar, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, about the day of the greater pilgrimage,
so he said: It is the day of slaughter, and the smaller one is Umrah.
